universal.name: PM-KISAN
universal.details: Direct income support scheme providing ₹6000/year to eligible farmers in three equal installments.
universal.eligibility: All small and marginal landholding farmer families with valid land records (see official portal for exclusions).

universal.name: Soil Health Card (SHC)
universal.details: Provides soil testing and nutrient-based recommendations to farmers via state labs and mobile soil testing vans.
universal.eligibility: All farmers can apply for soil testing and receive a soil health card.

universal.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
universal.details: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers in case of crop loss due to natural calamities.
universal.eligibility: Farmers who have insurable crops and have paid/pending premium per scheme rules.

rice.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
rice.details: Provides funds to states for agricultural infrastructure and targeted schemes; may include rice productivity projects.
rice.eligibility: State implementing agencies; farmer groups for supported projects.
rice.implementingAgency: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / State Agriculture Departments

wheat.name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM) - Wheat
wheat.details: Targeted interventions to increase wheat yield including subsidies for quality seed and micronutrients.
wheat.eligibility: Farmers participating in NFSM programs in targeted districts.
